result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by requiring up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, machine-readable data return within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. However, it unnecessarily extends the return and deletion obligations to Confidential Information and Works, including works in progress. Requiring Works to be returned within 30 days may also conflict with section 6(c), which conditions their delivery and assignment on final payment. The clause is generally professional but should be limited to Company Data and coordinated with the existing Works provisions.
